codeReview.summary: The commit improves auth test coverage, but the new browser assertion does not actually exercise the real failing /api/auth/callback path required by the feature contract and follow-up validation scope.

issues.description: The new Playwright test visits `/api/auth/callback?token_hash=already-used-test-token&redirectedFrom=%2Fguest%2Fdashboard` without a real/invalid auth token fixture, then only asserts that the browser ends up on `/auth` and that the guest link href contains an error query. This can pass on the route's generic missing/invalid-token fallback (`auth_failed`) without proving the required expired/invalid/already-used callback failure handling, so it does not satisfy the feature contract or the follow-up `cover-auth-callback-failure-path` expectation to exercise the real failing callback path.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker noted that Playwright leaves `test-results/.last-run.json` dirty after local runs. This is reusable validator knowledge and is already documented in `.factory/library/user-testing.md`, so no additional shared-state update is needed.
